anyOf.description: The step algorithm to be used, fixed or variable
The step algorithm to be used, fixed or variable

connections.description: A map of connections where the key and value strings are on the form form "{FMU}.instanceName.signal". The mapping is from output to inputs. As a single output can be connected to multiple inputs

endTime.description: The duration of the simulation in seconds. This is used by the fmus to allocate memory.

environmentParameters.description: A list of parameters which should be obtained from the environment. The strings are on the form form "{FMU}.instanceName.signal".

fmus.description: A map of from fmu names on the form "{FMU}" to the path of the .fmu file

logLevels.description: A map of enabled log levels for each FMU. The key is "{FMU}.instanceName" and the log levels are the categories specified for each FMU

logVariables.description: A map from fmu instance "{FMU}.instanceName" to a list of signal names.

stepCondition.description: The condition that should be true for the step to be allowed. It could be (true)

swapCondition.description: The condition that should be true for the model to be swapped in i.e. replacing the previous. The condition could look like (controller.valve ==true) if the instance controller exist and have value as a boolean signal

swapConnections.description: A map of new connections like the connections but only with the delta for this new instance. Keys and values are on the form  "{FMU}.instanceName.signal". The key is the output and values the inputs

swapInstance.description: The name of the instance swapped in

modelSwaps.description: A map of from an instance name to its swap configuration. Thus the key is the instance name in this simulation.

modelTransfers.description: A mapping from current instance name to the new instance name of that instance being transferred. i.e. A->A if A is transferred as is.

overrideLogLevel.description: Override global log level of the simulator

parallelSimulation.description: If true the dostep part of the algorithm is run in parallel.

parameters.description: A map from signal to its value. The key must be on the form "{FMU}.instanceName.signal" and value can be any value matching the signal.

reportProgress.description: If true the simulation will attempt to report progress.

simulationProgramDelay.description: Delay simulation steps. i.e. steps are slowed down to near real time.

startTime.description: The start time of the simulation. Usually 0.
